name: Movie night in
about: Blankets, snacks and a film you've both never seen. Take turns vetoing until one sticks.

name: Cook-off at home
about: Pick one ingredient, each cook a dish with it, then score each other's plate out of ten.

name: Board games and takeaway
about: Order in from your favourite place and play best of three. Loser washes up.

name: Home spa evening
about: Face masks, a bath, candles and a playlist. Phones in a drawer for the night.

name: Playlist swap
about: Each make a ten-song playlist that tells the other something about you. Listen with the lights low.

name: Garden stargazing
about: Blankets, hot chocolate and a star-map app. Best on a clear night with no moon.

name: Saddington Reservoir walk
about: Quiet loop around the reservoir and back along the canal. Bring a flask.

name: Canal walk to Kibworth for a drink
about: Wander the Grand Union towpath, then warm up in a Kibworth pub.

name: Foxton Locks walk and pub
about: Walk the staircase of ten locks, watch the boats, then food by the water.

name: Dinner date in Market Harborough
about: Stroll the old town, then pick a restaurant neither of you has tried.

name: Pottery painting
about: Paint something for each other. You collect it a week later, so it's a second date too.

name: Leicester Botanic Garden
about: Free gardens and glasshouses. Good for a slow afternoon and a coffee after.

name: Cinema and dinner in Leicester
about: Food first, then the biggest film on. Highcross has both under one roof.

name: Bowling and arcade
about: Two games, loser buys the milkshakes.

name: Escape room
about: Sixty minutes to get out together. Book ahead.

name: Mini golf
about: Nine or eighteen holes with a drink in hand.

name: Axe throwing
about: Surprisingly fun, and an instructor shows you how. Book a slot.

name: Bouldering session
about: Indoor climbing with shoe hire. Beginners welcome, no ropes needed.

name: Board game cafe
about: Hundreds of games, staff who explain the rules, and cake.

name: Curry on the Golden Mile
about: Some of the best Indian food in the country, then sweets from a mithai shop to take home.

name: Show at the Curve
about: Musicals and plays at Leicester's big theatre. Check what's on first.

name: Gig at De Montfort Hall
about: Concerts and comedy in a proper old hall. Check the listings.

name: Leicester Museum and Art Gallery
about: Free entry: dinosaurs, Egyptian mummies and a gallery of paintings, then a walk down New Walk.

name: King Richard III Visitor Centre
about: Where the king was found under a car park, then the cathedral next door.

name: National Space Centre
about: Rockets, the planetarium show and a lot of buttons to press.

name: Leicester Tigers match
about: Big crowd, loud atmosphere, food at the ground. Check the fixtures.

name: Kelmarsh Hall gardens
about: Pretty walled gardens and tea room. Open spring to autumn, so check dates.

name: Rockingham Castle
about: Castle on a hill with views over three counties. Seasonal opening.

name: Uppingham wander and lunch
about: Small market town with bookshops, galleries and good cafes.

name: Watermead Country Park
about: Lakes, a woolly mammoth statue and flat paths. Easy, relaxed walk.

name: Pitsford Water loop
about: Walk or cycle round the reservoir, then cake at the cafe.

name: Trampoline park
about: An hour of bouncing like kids. Grip socks required.

name: Afternoon tea
about: Scones, sandwiches and too many cakes. Book a table.

name: Bradgate Park walk
about: Deer, ruins and the climb up to Old John for the view. Pub in Newtown Linford after.

name: Sunset at Burrough Hill
about: Iron Age hill fort with huge views. Take a picnic and watch the sun go down.

name: Bosworth Battlefield
about: Heritage centre and walking trail where the Wars of the Roses ended.

name: Great Central Railway steam train
about: Ride a steam train through the countryside. Check the running days.

name: Melton Mowbray food trip
about: Proper pork pies, Stilton and the market. Picnic on the way home.

name: Wicksteed Park
about: Lake, old-school rides and a lakeside walk. Entry is free, rides cost extra.

name: Day out in Coventry
about: The old and new cathedrals, the Transport Museum (free), then dinner.

name: Rutland Water bike ride
about: Hire bikes and ride round the reservoir. The full loop is about 23 miles; the Hambleton loop is shorter.

name: Rutland Water picnic and walk
about: Walk out to Normanton Church on the water's edge and picnic by the shore.

name: Paddleboarding on Rutland Water
about: Hire boards or take a taster lesson. Summer months.

name: Twycross Zoo
about: Big on apes and monkeys. Book online for cheaper tickets.

name: Twinlakes Park
about: Rides and play areas that grown-ups can enjoy too. Check seasons.

name: Oakham and Rutland day
about: Oakham Castle's horseshoes, the market square and a long lunch.

name: Warwick Castle
about: A full day: towers, shows and the river. Book online in advance for cheaper tickets.

name: Leamington Spa evening
about: Jephson Gardens, the Parade, then dinner somewhere nice.

name: Spa twilight session
about: Pool, sauna and a treatment each. Many hotels near Leicester do evening deals.

name: Stamford and Burghley House
about: Walk the deer park to Burghley, then the old stone streets of Stamford for dinner.

name: Conkers in the National Forest
about: Forest trails, treetop walkway and an indoor centre if it rains.

name: Belvoir Castle
about: Fairy-tale castle on a hill with gardens and big views. Seasonal opening.

name: Ice skating in Nottingham
about: Public skate sessions, then food in the Lace Market.
maps: Motorpoint Arena National Ice Centre Nottingham

name: Wollaton Hall
about: The house from Batman, a deer park and lake. Park entry is free; parking costs.

name: Snowdome skiing taster
about: Real snow indoors. Book a beginner lesson or a tobogganing session.

name: Stratford-upon-Avon
about: Riverside walk, rowing boat, then a play at the RSC if you can get tickets.
